title: Resolve external pose-driver interface and add minimal pose-driver harness
description:
## Summary
Decide and document the interface an EXTERNAL movement/animation rig uses to drive the creature (the MVP rig is externally supplied and out of scope), and provide a minimal in-repo pose-driver TEST HARNESS so the idle/walk MVP is demonstrable before the external rig exists. Run early because it fixes the interface shape the adapter (0132) and perf budget (0134) measure against.

## Scope
- Decide: (a) external rig drives bones procedurally via `CreatureRig.ApplyPose(PosedSkeleton)` directly (no Animator/Avatar), OR (b) external rig expects a Unity `Animator` with a `Generic` `Avatar` built over the bone hierarchy for clip playback/blending (requires `Avatar` construction from `SkeletonSnapshot`, which does not exist). Record the decision and its rationale in an ADR-style note.
- Document the rig->CreatureCreator contract: bone set/naming/count expectations (indexed vs string), coordinate space, mirror handling, whether fixed or morphology-variable, and how external identity maps once (external->semantic->SkeletonSnapshot index) with no per-frame string resolution.
- Provide a MINIMAL authored-pose test harness that feeds Idle/Walk poses through the chosen boundary purely to exercise the SMR + binding + perf stack (a test double, NOT a locomotion framework / Animator controller / gait system).

## Acceptance Criteria
- A decision record names the chosen driver interface and the rejected alternative with rationale.
- A minimal PlayMode spike proves the chosen driver moves a real bone / posed mesh one frame.
- No internal idle/walk ANIMATOR, locomotion state machine, gait, or animation-clip subsystem is added (that belongs to the external rig / TSK-0010/0011).

## Validation
Decision + short ADR note; one PlayMode spike moving a bone or posed mesh through the chosen boundary. dotnet builds + git diff --check.

## Findings
Confirmed (source/HEAD e88ba5d): no Animator/Avatar/HumanBodyBones usage anywhere; CreatureRig already exposes an indexed ApplyPose path. All four substantive audits agree the rig is external and out of scope and warn not to build a second animation framework.

## Blockers
The external rig's expected interface is not specified by the user (external effort); this task pins it down so wiring is not built twice.

## Next Step
Run EARLY (cheap decision) before 0132 final wiring. Parented under the rig/pose owner TSK-0073.
